integrity: Exact algebraic global proof with independent symbolic checks and deterministic numerical quadrature corroboration. Code uses SymPy and NumPy. Numerical experiments do not prove global sharpness.
scientific_limitations: Real-valued harmonic polynomials of Euclidean degree <=2, probability-normalized disk area. Not a result for complex-valued harmonic maps, weighted measures, other dimensions, or higher degrees. Priority under other terminology not independently certified.
title: Sharp fourth moment and full three-degree rigidity for real harmonic quadratics on the disk
